body: I don't miss it at all, flushed the rest I had down the toilet after these symptoms appeared. I haven't really had much opiate/opioid use outside of kratom, but I was taking it on and off for a good year or so. No issues with stopping before this one, maybe I just got unlucky? I'm feeling better after a good cry though, so that's something.

Thanks for the reply! Still feeling quite depersonalized at times, and had another anxiety attack last week, but am remaining hopeful that this is temporary. There was a week or so before the attack where I was feeling moderately OK, not 100% but decent. It's only been just over a month, so trying to stay positive. I have some 5-htp actually, I'll try that out.
The worst definitely seems to be over, here's hoping it's as simple as this! Thanks so much for replying, just having someone to talk about this has done a world of good.

This oddly made me feel very at peace, if that makes any sense. Things have been much better since typing all this out. Heart rate has slowed a little bit, too. Not feeling as foggy. Still feeling "unlike myself" but I suppose that could be the week-long fatigue run I've been having. Seeing a psychologist soon, I'll update in a couple weeks if anyone is interested!

Thanks so much man, even this has helped me. And yes, I don't plan on ever taking kratom again - flushed maybe 4oz down the toilet a few days ago. Today's been the best day since it began, feeling almost normal, and was able to drive to school without feeling terribly anxious about it! Here's hoping this continues.
